earnings.title: Date: October 27, 2026 NEWS RELEASE
highlights: Q3 diluted EPS of $4.94; adjusted diluted EPS of $5.91 (up 14% y/y)
FY 2026 diluted EPS expected range of $17.30-$17.50; raising adj. diluted EPS to $20.40-$20.60
Utility Solutions segment net sales in the third quarter of 2026 increased 9% to $1,028 million compared to $944 million reported in the third quarter of 2025.
Organic net sales increased approximately 5 % in the quarter compared to the third quarter of 2025.

quotes.text: Hubbell delivered strong financial performance in the third quarter, with double digit growth in organic sales, adjusted operating profit, adjusted earnings per share and free cash flow
quotes.by: Gerben Bakker, Chairman, President and CEO

outlook: For the full year 2026, Hubbell anticipates total sales growth of 18-19%, including organic sales growth of 10-11%.
Hubbell expects 2026 GAAP diluted earnings per share in the range of $17.30 to $17.50 and adjusted diluted earnings per share (“Adjusted EPS”) in the range of $20.40 to $20.60.

For the full year, Adjusted EPS excludes amortization of acquisition-related intangible assets, which the Company expects to be approximately $2.50 per share, and transaction, integration, and separation costs, which the Company expects to be approximately $0.60 per share.
The Company expects full year 2026 free cash flow conversion of approximately 90% on adjusted net income.

items.heading: Inflation and other unfavorable economic conditions may adversely affect our business results of operations and financial condition.
We operate in markets that are subject to competitive pressures that could affect selling prices or demand for our products.
Volatility in currency exchange rates may adversely affect our financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.
Our ability to effectively develop and introduce new products could adversely affect our ability to compete.

We manufacture and source products and materials from various countries throughout the world. A disruption in the availability, price or quality of these products or materials could adversely affect our operating results.
We may be required to recognize impairment charges for our goodwill and other intangible assets.
